items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: his name was Bill Miles and he was spoiled... So, he married me for my money and I married him for his.

ctx.x: Steal shortening out of gingerbread? I’ll tell you, I’d like to know who was the second husband.
Oh my God, his name was Bill Miles and he was spoiled. He was a mama’s boy. So, he married me for my money and I married him for his. We both got fooled.
Really? So how long did you stay with this one and which one was the most handsome?
